hard_rules: The Codebook is the scientific product. The UI is a client.
The packet, not the picture, is the prediction.
The pixel must have a provenance path.
EXP-0002 remains behind the public reveal firewall.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: TRANSFER
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Held-out structural recurrence survives predefined tests/nulls.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: RETRODICT
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Hidden observed phenotype/trait state is predicted before reveal.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: INTERPOLATE
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Predict states between supported observed points with calibrated uncertainty.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: CROSS-CONTEXT TRANSFER
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Mechanism/state mapping transfers to an independent lineage/context.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: EXTRAPOLATE
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Propose unobserved but constraint-compatible states; must remain explicitly hypothetical until observed or tested.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: INTERVENTION
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Predict effects of perturbation; requires independent experimental validation and cannot be inferred from visualization alone.

benchmarks.name: Heliconius cydno alithea Forewing Color Blind Retrodiction
benchmarks.purpose: First real-data bridge benchmark for LIFE-CODE predictive infrastructure. Predict a deliberately hidden, binary forewing color phenotype (yellow vs white) for held-out H. cydno alithea males using genomic information while semantic annotation is locked.

scientific_boundary.reason: The published resource already contains genotype/variant and phenotype data. It is therefore ideal for testing blind prediction contracts, but any recovery of the known K-locus/aristaless biology is validation, not novelty.

frozen_split_contract.note: Labels may be used by the orchestration layer only to create a balanced split. Held-out phenotype labels are then sealed and unavailable to inference until reveal.

success_gates: All source files hashed before analysis.
Subject ID mapping resolved without phenotype leakage.
Train/holdout split generated deterministically and frozen.
Held-out truth stored separately; only its SHA-256 visible pre-reveal.
Prediction packet emitted for all 22 holdout subjects.
Primary score is balanced accuracy plus Brier/log-loss style calibration; not visual realism.
Permutation/null labels and phylogeny/population-structure baselines are evaluated.
Post-reveal semantic concordance is recorded as new evidence, never used to rewrite the frozen prediction.

benchmarks.name: Sebastes Longevity Resilience
benchmarks.purpose: Test whether annotation-blind structural and history diffs across repeated lifespan transitions recover recurrent biological subsystems before semantic reveal.

analysis_strategy.stage_1: Build sequence-only whole-genome distance/tree and structural feature inventory across the panel.
analysis_strategy.stage_2: Identify multiple independent close branch contrasts using the frozen tree and trait key.
analysis_strategy.stage_3: Compute Biological Diff for each contrast before annotation reveal.
analysis_strategy.stage_4: Intersect recurrent structural/rewiring deltas across independent contrasts.
analysis_strategy.stage_5: Apply body-size, depth, phylogenetic and composition controls; preserve conflicting branches.
analysis_strategy.stage_6: Reveal annotation and compare recovered subsystems to known longevity biology; do not equate overlap with causality.

benchmarks.name: Heliconius Pattern Reachability
benchmarks.purpose: Validate whether LIFE-CODE can recover and retrodict modular visible pattern states from sequence-derived structure before attempting novel phenotype extrapolation.
benchmarks.first_validation: Leave-one-taxon-or-race-out phenotype retrodiction followed by actual phenotype reveal.
